title: Guaranteed error bounds for AC loss calculations in type-II superconductors: a certified framework from the Bean model to the E-J power law via a space-time convex-duality estimate: source code

creators.name: Talleb, Hakeim
creators.affiliation: Sorbonne Universite, CNRS, Laboratoire de Genie Electrique et Electronique de Paris, 75252, Paris, France; Universite Paris-Saclay, CentraleSupelec, CNRS, Laboratoire de Genie Electrique et Electronique de Paris, 91192, Gif-sur-Yvette, France

description: Source code for the manuscript 'Guaranteed error bounds for AC loss calculations in type-II superconductors: a certified framework from the Bean model to the E-J power law via a space-time convex-duality estimate' (H. Talleb, Superconductor Science and Technology, manuscript SUST-107877, under revision, 2026). Computes mathematically guaranteed two-sided bounds on the AC loss per cycle of a type-II superconducting slab in a parallel field, from the Bean critical-state model (Prigozhin sweeping process, exact-in-time Moreau catch-up, dual quadratic-programming certificates) to the E-J power law (proximal steps, exact primal-dual gap identity), and a space-time Brezis-Ekeland-Nayroles majorant (Theorem 1) that certifies spatial, temporal and quantity-of-interest errors simultaneously. Version 1.1.0 (revision) adds the certificate of the Bean model on meshes not aligned with the drive, the comparison lemma certifying the exact sinusoidal drive, the loss-effectivity analysis, a time-dependent Jc test and the script producing every new number of the revised paper. Four verification suites (46 tests) reproduce every number and figure of the paper.
